features: 单实例多数据库动态切换
数据库连接管理（连接测试、配置刷新、健康检查、自动重连）
数据库架构查询（数据库列表、表列表、视图列表、表结构、列信息、主键、索引等）
数据库架构操作（创建/删除/重命名表、添加/删除/修改列、索引管理、约束管理等）
类型化有界查询（query_database、主键游标及选列/筛选/排序分页、多结果集、批量只读查询）
MongoDB 集合查询与写入（基于 SqlSugar.MongoDbCore ADO，支持查找、聚合、批量读写与清空）
数据操作（参数化执行 DML、单行整数自增插入）
存储过程调用（简单调用、带输出参数）
批量操作（非原子命令批次、受支持 provider 的原子 DML 批次）
MCP Resources、Prompts、连接名补全与健康检查进度通知
SQL Server 特殊支持（GO 语句执行）
参数化查询防止 SQL 注入
数据库能力和配置诊断（驱动可用性、优化选项作用范围、产品验证状态）
security: 参数化查询防止 SQL 注入

name: io.github.ttcc666/database-mcp-server
description: 数据库 MCP 服务器，提供 54 个工具，支持多数据库连接、有界 SQL 查询、结构管理、MongoDB 集合操作、流式导出及 MCP 资源和提示词。

environmentVariables.name: DB_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: 数据库配置文件绝对路径（可选）。未设置时会按顺序自动查找 DB_CONFIG_PATH -> %USERPROFILE%/.database-mcp/databases.json。推荐显式设置，如 D:\config\databases.json。配置文件格式请参考 databases.json.example

environmentVariables.name: SEQ_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Seq 日志服务器地址（可选），如 http://localhost:5341

environmentVariables.name: SEQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Seq API 密钥（可选），用于认证和高级功能

environmentVariables.name: DB_DDL_WHITELIST
environmentVariables.description: DDL 操作白名单（可选），分号分隔的正则表达式，用于放行特定的 DDL 操作

tools.name: add_column
tools.description: Add a column using a typed column definition.

tools.name: add_column_remark
tools.description: Attach a description to tableName.columnName, making the column meaning visible to downstream tools.

tools.name: add_default_value
tools.description: Set defaultValue on tableName.columnName by invoking DbMaintenance.AddDefaultValue.

tools.name: add_primary_key
tools.description: Create a primary key constraint on tableName for columnName or composite columnNames.

tools.name: add_table_remark
tools.description: Attach a description to tableName so schema consumers can surface the table’s purpose.

tools.name: backup_table
tools.description: Use the provider's table-copy capability to create newTableName from oldTableName. Not a complete database backup: indexes, constraints, triggers, grants and recovery semantics are provider-dependent.

tools.name: batch_execute_commands
tools.description: Execute typed commands sequentially. Default atomic=false preserves per-item success and partial commits. Explicit atomic=true prevalidates ordinary DML and commits all or rolls back; transactionOutcome=unknown requires verification before retry. External trigger side effects and sequences are outside this guarantee.

tools.name: batch_sql_query
tools.description: Execute 1-5 independent read-only SQL queries sequentially over one connection and return success, rowCount, data, or error per query.

tools.name: call_stored_procedure
tools.description: Invoke a stored procedure with typed Input, Output, InputOutput or ReturnValue parameters; return rows and outputParameters. Output directions support SQL Server/MySQL; ReturnValue supports SQL Server.

tools.name: create_index
tools.description: Create an index named indexName on tableName for columnName or composite columnNames; set isUnique to true to build a unique index and return success.

tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Create a table from typed project column definitions: name, dataType, length, precision, scale, nullable, primaryKey, identity, comment, defaultExpression.

tools.name: delete_column_remark
tools.description: Delete the stored description for tableName.columnName and return success.

tools.name: delete_table_remark
tools.description: Remove the remark/description associated with tableName and return success.

tools.name: drop_column
tools.description: Drop the specified columnName from tableName and return success.

tools.name: drop_constraint
tools.description: Drop the specified constraintName from tableName (primary key, unique index, foreign key, etc.) and return success.

tools.name: drop_func
tools.description: Drop the database function identified by functionName, typically during cleanup.

tools.name: drop_index
tools.description: Drop the specified indexName on tableName and return success.

tools.name: drop_proc
tools.description: Drop the stored procedure identified by procedureName and return success.

tools.name: drop_table
tools.description: Immediately drop the specified tableName, removing both structure and data, and return success to indicate completion.

tools.name: drop_view
tools.description: Drop the specified viewName definition and return success.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Execute INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE SQL after dangerous-operation detection, binding typed parameters, and return affectedRows.

tools.name: execute_command_with_go
tools.description: Execute a SQL Server script that contains GO batches, automatically splitting the script and returning total affectedRows.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Get an estimated execution plan for one SELECT/CTE without executing the target query. SQL Server requires SHOWPLAN; PostgreSQL uses ANALYZE FALSE; MySQL uses EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON; SQLite uses EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN. Planning is not a security sandbox for functions: use a database read-only role. No actual execution statistics or universal cost units.

tools.name: get_current_database
tools.description: Return the currently active database connection name and database type so callers know the execution context. In CLI tool mode, this reflects the persisted current selection for the resolved config path.

tools.name: get_data_base_list
tools.description: Call DbMaintenance.GetDataBaseList to retrieve every database the instance can see and return it inside the data array.

tools.name: get_data_set_all
tools.description: Execute SQL that may contain multiple SELECT statements and return each result set with its rowCount inside resultSets. Values retain the driver reader types; duplicate column names receive unique suffixes.

tools.name: get_database_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect configured provider capabilities, budgets and settings without connecting to the database. No credentials are returned.

tools.name: get_database_config
tools.description: Summarize DB_CONFIG_PATH or DB_CONNECTION_STRING/DB_TYPE and return the active connection name, description, database type, masked connection string, and mode metadata.

tools.name: get_object_definition
tools.description: Read an object's native definition. Use identity from list_objects as name (including PostgreSQL overload arguments or table.trigger). definition-unavailable can mean absent, encrypted, invisible or unsupported definition; it does not assert absence. SQL Server/PostgreSQL table DDL reconstruction is not provided.

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Read metadata for one table or 1-50 tables with per-table status and shared output budgets. Native readers support asynchronous cancellation. Other SQL providers use synchronous driver metadata for basic sections. Refresh bypasses the metadata cache.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Perform a comprehensive health check on all configured database connections, testing connectivity and response time for each.

tools.name: insert_row
tools.description: Insert one row using SqlSugar and return its integer identity as a decimal string (Int64). Supports SQL Server/MySQL/SQLite with one SqlSugar-recognized integer identity; SQLite requires AUTOINCREMENT. Defaults, constraints and triggers run in the database. Cancellation does not guarantee rollback; do not retry without checking the outcome.

tools.name: is_any_column
tools.description: Check whether columnName exists on tableName and return an exists boolean.

tools.name: is_any_constraint
tools.description: Check whether the specified constraintName exists (unique, foreign key, or check constraint) and return an exists boolean.

tools.name: is_any_table
tools.description: Check whether tableName exists in the current database and return an exists boolean.

tools.name: is_any_table_remark
tools.description: Return exists to show whether tableName already has a stored remark.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List every configured database connection (name, type, description, default flag, current flag) so callers can choose a target.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List tables, views, routines or triggers. MySQL/SQL Server/PostgreSQL/SQLite use native keyset paging; other SQL providers use SqlSugar metadata with client-side filtering/paging and report pagingMode. Visibility depends on database permissions. Pass the returned identity to get_object_definition where supported. Cursor is bound to filters, configuration content/path, working directory and database; it supports cross-process continuation without a cross-page snapshot.

tools.name: mongo_aggregate
tools.description: Run a read-only Mongo aggregation via SqlSugar's built-in ADO with a server row limit and response byte budget after provider materialization. Output uses provider-converted JSON, not lossless BSON; nested BSON uses Extended JSON. Supports match/project/group/sort and same-database $lookup/$facet. Nested pipelines share 64 stages, at most 4 levels and 8 facet branches; no nested facet inside facet, writes or JavaScript.

tools.name: mongo_delete
tools.description: Batch delete MongoDB documents via SqlSugar.MongoDbCore ADO deleteMany. Requires write access and enableDangerousOperations. Empty filter also requires allowAll. Returns deletedCount and writeOutcome.

tools.name: mongo_find
tools.description: Find MongoDB documents via SqlSugar's built-in ADO using JSON objects / Extended JSON v2 input. Output uses provider-converted JSON: ObjectId becomes string, missing fields become null; nested BSON uses Extended JSON. Not a lossless BSON round trip. Stable sort appends _id; concurrent writes can move pages. limitReached with truncated=null means row ceiling; truncated=true means byte ceiling.

tools.name: mongo_insert_many
tools.description: Insert one or more MongoDB documents via SqlSugar.MongoDbCore ADO insertMany using JSON / Extended JSON v2 objects (1-1000 documents, <= 4 MiB total). Requires write access and acknowledged write concern (not w=0).

tools.name: mongo_truncate
tools.description: Remove all documents in a MongoDB collection via cancellable SqlSugar ADO deleteMany, preserving the collection and indexes. Requires schema-admin access and enableDangerousOperations; cancellation does not roll back writes.

tools.name: mongo_update
tools.description: Batch update MongoDB documents via SqlSugar.MongoDbCore ADO updateMany. Requires write access and enableDangerousOperations. Empty filter also requires allowAll. Returns affected count and writeOutcome.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Execute a read-only database query. Explicit database target, typed JSON parameters, bounded rows/bytes and structured results. Returns the actual database and configuration version. Use schema tools before writing SQL; limitReached means use narrower filters or stable pagination.

tools.name: query_table_page
tools.description: Query a table page with non-null primary keys. Without columns/filters/orderBy, stream rows with byte checks and use nextCursor for keyset continuation. Supplying any of these options uses SqlSugar page-based offset pagination, loads the whole page before checking response bytes, appends missing primary keys to sorting, and returns no cursor. No COUNT or cross-page snapshot; NULL ordering follows the database.

tools.name: reload_database_config
tools.description: Reload the databases.json file from DB_CONFIG_PATH, update connection admission state, and return the applied currentDatabase plus whether the previous selection was preserved. In CLI tool mode, the preserved selection is also persisted for later invocations.

tools.name: rename_column
tools.description: Rename oldColumnName to newColumnName within tableName to adjust field naming.

tools.name: rename_table
tools.description: Rename oldTableName to newTableName and return success so callers know the rename succeeded.

tools.name: switch_database
tools.description: Switch the active connection to databaseName and return previousDatabase/currentDatabase; throw an error if the name does not exist. In CLI tool mode, the selected connection is persisted per resolved config path for later invocations.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Test a named or current connection with a fixed target snapshot, optional transient retries and a total deadline. Default: no retries. Backoff releases the execution slot.

tools.name: truncate_table
tools.description: Execute TRUNCATE on tableName to delete all rows while preserving the schema; the response includes success.

tools.name: update_column
tools.description: Modify an existing column using a typed column definition.

tools.name: validate_configuration
tools.description: Verify whether the environment variables or config file can produce a usable connection and return success/configured/currentDatabase/databaseType/message fields describing the outcome.
